name: Sivir
title: The Battle Mistress

passive.name: Fleet of Foot

description.normalized: Gains 31 Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds after dealing damage to an enemy champion with an attack or ability.

passive.rawParsedText: Gains 31 Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds after dealing damage to an enemy champion with an attack or ability.

q.name: Boomerang Blade

description.normalized: Sivir hurls her crossblade, dealing 10 / 30 / 50 / 70 (75% / 80% / 85% / 90% AD + 60% AP) physical damage to all enemies it cuts through. For every 1% Critical Rate, damage is increased by 0.5%. The higher the Attack Speed, the shorter the cast time. Deals 80% damage against non-champion enemies.

Deals 80% damage against non-champion enemies.

w.name: Ricochet

description.normalized: Gains 25% / 30% / 35% / 40% Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Her attacks bounce to nearby enemies, dealing 4 / 6 / 8 / 10 (+15% / 18% / 21% / 24% AD) physical damage. If the first attack critically strikes, so will the bounces. Deals 75% damage to minions. Each enemy can be hit by a maximum of 2 bounces.

e.name: Spell Shield

description.normalized: Gains a spell shield for 2 seconds. Heals herself for 38 ( 65% / 70% / 75% / 80% AD + 50% AP) Health and gains Fleet of Foot when she blocks an ability. If the block fails, 50% of the ability's cooldown is refunded.

r.name: On The Hunt

description.normalized: Grants 15% bonus Movement Speed to nearby allied champions for 10 / 11 / 12 seconds. During this period, her basic ability cooldowns are reduced by 20% / 25% / 30%. Unyielding Valor: While the Hunt is active, gains 1 stack of Morale every time an attack or ability deals damage to an enemy champion, and 2 stacks of Morale after a champion takedown. Each stack of Morale grants 2 / 3 / 4 AD. At 8 stacks, grants an additional 25% bonus Movement Speed to nearby allied champions and refreshes On the Hunt's duration.
